title: 第610章 白虎境况第609章 契约反噬
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 白虎雪白的毛发上血色斑斑，素日湛蓝澄澈的眼眸染上了一抹灰败，
巫未央看清了周围人的面孔，几只虎妖，一个魔修。
中心大陆，果然还存在魔修！
那魔修本往圆台上施展着术法，可突然停了下来。
“离三大人，是出什么情况了？”
为首身披虎裘，身形健硕高大的虎妖见他停手，立马粗声问道。
离三紧紧盯着圆台上的白虎，冷声问道，“那个人族在哪？”
虎妖皱眉，“你是说小崽子那个主人？大概还在北陆里挣扎吧，死不了。”
“这小崽子不死，他想死也死不了。”
“你不是说屏蔽了契约？关心那个人族干什么？”
“你应该将他也带回来。”离三感受到契约里的屏障竟被破掉了，内心震惊不已。
“这小崽子气性大得很，不留下那个人族，捉不了它回来。”虎妖语气有些不耐烦了，“之前早就告诉你了，你当时可没反对。”
离三不言，沉眸盯着前方，能破掉屏障的只有一个人，巫未央！
他双手抬起，银光汇聚，射向圆台。
禁制的纹路轮转，强大的力量波动在殿堂内翻涌。
虎妖被震退了两步，脸上却露出疯狂的笑容。
其他虎妖亦是如此，一个个狂热地盯着圆台上的白虎。
而白虎在禁制之下痛苦哀嚎，它屡次想要翻身抵抗，却只能一次次还没站起就倒下。
白虎又一次重重倒下，庞大的身躯在地面砸出一声巨响，它头颅贴着地面，蓝眸溢出水光，融入血液中，“噫噫呜呜......”
另一边炼丹房见此情景的巫未央，清明眼眸中染上了一丝愤怒。
她的愤怒化作剑意降临那座囚禁白虎的殿堂。
霞光从白虎体内迸发，与禁制相撞，荡出恐怖余波，周围虎妖和魔修通通被震飞。
离三飞快从地上爬起，望见圆台上笼罩白虎的霞光，脸色极其难看。
“这是什么情况！”虎妖怒极，猛地看向离三，眼神质问。
离三却没理它，沉沉看了一眼圆台后，一挥黑袍消失了。
徒留一众虎妖在殿内发狂，试图靠近圆台，却被那股剑意震慑，不得不将这座殿堂暂时封了起来。
炼丹房内。
“咳咳。”沐暮咳嗽着从地上坐起，也不顾自己身上的伤，便朝巫未央深深低下头，“谢谢你。”
他的声音气若游丝，语气却十分郑重。
方才离三停手的时间，沐暮挣扎着清醒了过来，亲眼看到了白虎的情况，也清楚巫未央的作为，他心中感激不已。
“虎妖乃妖族强族，定然有不少修为高深的大妖，我的剑意坚持不了多久。”巫未央偏过脸，语气有些不忍，“而且，白风是被血月盯上了。”
血月二字一出，沐暮脑袋轰的一下，“血月？”
他宛如五雷轰顶，心神差点寂灭。
巫未央站起身将药炉中的汤药倒出，回头看向沐暮，将汤药递出，“所以，我们速度要快。”
content_en:
The white tiger's snow-white hair was stained with blood, and its normally blue and clear eyes were stained with a touch of gray.
Wu Weiyang could clearly see the faces of the people around him, including several tiger monsters and a demon cultivator.
As expected, there are still demonic cultivators in the Central Continent!
The demon cultivator was casting a spell on the round platform, but suddenly stopped.
"Master Li San, what happened?"
The leader, the tall and muscular tiger demon wearing tiger fur, saw him stop and immediately asked in a rough voice.
Li San stared closely at the white tiger on the round platform and asked coldly, "Where is that human race?"
The tiger demon frowned, "Are you talking about the owner of the little cub? He is probably still struggling in Hokuriku and cannot die."
"If this little kid doesn't die, he can't die even if he wants to."
"Didn't you say you blocked the contract? Why do you care about that human race?"
"You should bring him back too." Li San was shocked when he felt that the barrier in the contract had been broken.
"This little brat is very angry. If we don't keep that human race, we won't be able to catch it back." The tiger demon said in a somewhat impatient tone, "I told you before, but you didn't object at the time."
Li San remained silent and stared straight ahead. There was only one person who could break the barrier, Wu Weiyang!
He raised his hands, and the silver light gathered and shot towards the round platform.
The restricted lines rotated, and powerful power fluctuations surged in the hall.
The tiger demon was shaken back two steps, but a crazy smile appeared on his face.
The same goes for the other tiger monsters, each of them staring feverishly at the white tiger on the round platform.
The white tiger howled in pain under the restraint. It repeatedly tried to stand up and resist, but could only fall down again and again before standing up.
"Boom!"
The white tiger fell heavily again, and its huge body hit the ground with a loud noise. Its head was pressed against the ground, and its blue eyes overflowed with water and melted into the blood, "Grrrr..."
On the other side of the alchemy room, Wu Weiyang saw this scene, his clear eyes filled with anger.
Her anger turned into sword intent and descended on the palace where the white tiger was imprisoned.
The rays of light burst out from the white tiger's body and collided with the restriction, causing terrifying aftermath. All the surrounding tiger demons and demon cultivators were blown away.
Li San quickly got up from the ground and saw the glow of the white tiger on the round platform, his face was extremely ugly.
"What is going on!" The tiger demon was extremely angry and looked at Li San with questioning eyes.
Li San ignored it. After taking a deep look at the round platform, he waved his black robe and disappeared.
A group of tiger demons were left going crazy in the hall, trying to get close to the round platform, but were frightened by the sword intent and had to temporarily seal the hall.
In the alchemy room.
"Ahem." Mu Mu coughed and sat up from the ground. Regardless of his injuries, he bowed his head deeply towards Wu Weiyang, "Thank you."
His voice was breathless, but his tone was very solemn.
Just when Li San stopped, Mu Mu struggled to wake up. He saw Bai Hu's condition with his own eyes and understood Wu Weiyang's actions. He was extremely grateful.
"The tiger demon is a powerful demon clan, and there must be many great demons with advanced cultivation. My sword will will not last long." Wu Weiyang turned his face and said in a somewhat unbearable tone, "Besides, Bai Feng is being targeted by Xue Yue."
As soon as the word "blood moon" came out, Mu Mu's head banged, "Blood moon?"
It was like five thunders struck him, and his mind almost died.
Wu Weiyang stood up and poured out the soup from the medicine stove. She turned back to look at Mu Mu and handed out the soup, "So, we have to be fast."
